economy.summary: His campaign platform lists creating jobs that sustain families, communities, and a dignified retirement, protecting unions and prevailing wages, and raising the minimum wage.
economy.short: Supports job creation, union protections, prevailing wages, raising minimum wage.

taxes.summary: His campaign platform calls for closing tax loopholes and making corporations and the super-rich pay their fair share, and lowering property taxes while increasing state funding for schools.
taxes.short: Supports closing tax loopholes, lowering property taxes, more state funding.

abortion.summary: Co-sponsored House Bill 26 of the 2025-2026 session, the Reproductive Freedom Act, which would repeal existing Pennsylvania statutory restrictions on abortion.
abortion.short: Co-sponsored bill to repeal Pennsylvania abortion restrictions.

education.summary: His campaign platform supports full and fair K-12 school funding, Pre-K for all, affordable paths to higher education, and certified trade schools and training programs.
education.short: Supports K-12 funding, Pre-K for all, trade schools.

guns.summary: His campaign platform lists stopping the epidemic of gun violence in communities, streets, and schools among his priorities.
guns.short: Lists stopping gun violence in communities, streets, schools as priority.
